title: HB0944 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 4, Chapter 54; Section 38-3-119 and Title 39, Chapter 17, relative to firearms.

provenance.note: Draft dated 2025-02-04 (as filed). The 39-17-1330(a) quote stops before a page footer; the sentence goes on to 'attachment, or accessory that is designed or functions to accelerate the rate of fire of a semiautomatic rifle but does not convert the semiautomatic rifle into a machine gun'.  Section 1 defines 'assault weapon' by a long model list and feature test (not quoted); Section 4 exempts weapons possessed before July 1, 2025. Section 5 also has department of safety certificate and transfer rules. Amendments, if any, are not in the text read.
